description:
You are an IT Project Manager at TailwindTraders responsible for ensuring the team delivers a healthy, sustainable sprint. Sprint 1 is currently loaded with a significant number of user stories and bugs, all demanding immediate attention. The team has no capacity plan configured and no triage has been performed.

Your goals:
1. Configure realistic daily capacity for team members in Sprint 1 (navigate to Boards > Sprints > Sprint 1 > Capacity tab and set hours per day for the available team members)
2. Audit the sprint backlog and determine which work items can be deferred: move at least two lower-priority work items from Sprint 1 to Sprint 2, prioritizing the retention of Priority 1 bugs and high-priority user stories
3. For each work item you move out of Sprint 1, add a comment explaining why it was deferred

Login URL: http://localhost/DefaultCollection
Username: Docker
Password: GymAnything123!

sprint1_items: Implement product inventory search with full-text filtering
Design REST API rate limiting and authentication middleware
Product price calculation returns incorrect values for bulk discount tiers
API returns 500 error when filtering products with special characters in category name
Inventory count becomes negative after concurrent stock deduction requests
